counter.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI asset for STILLDRAWN, a dark painterly paper-world metroidvania. Generate a landscape 3:2 transparent cutout of an antique bookbinder's trading counter, FRONT VIEW, symmetrical, no perspective distortion. The panel fills almost the whole canvas with a torn-paper/aged charcoal wood outer silhouette, desaturated graphite and taupe textures, restrained antique bronze trim. This must visibly feel like a small trading shop, NOT an open journal, NOT a website dashboard. Three adjacent shallow display niches across the middle: left niche holds a small beautifully bound weathered book with ivory reinforcing spine, middle holds a muted red healing vial in a stitched leather satchel, right holds a few violet-black ink crystals hovering just above a little dish. All objects painterly, detailed large textured forms matching carved layered paper cavern terrain, NO photorealism, NO pixel art. Each product centered at x=25%,50%,75% and y=44%, keeping its silhouette small enough for broad readable empty zones below. Blank dark paper name strips centered above each product at y=27%; blank dark labels at y=64%; a small blank price-tag area under each at y=73%. Top 8%-20% is broad dark unobstructed empty title/currency space. Lower 81%-93% is a wide empty dark paper counter lip for description and buttons. Thin upright shelves and warm dim candle glow at far left/right edges only. Quiet subtle paper fiber and wood grain, very legible negative space, refined PC game shop interface. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO UI cursor, NO humanoid merchant, NO extra panels. Outside silhouette is genuinely transparent alpha. Output aspect 3:2, highest practical resolution.

choice.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. A production transparent game interaction confirmation panel asset, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, designed for STILLDRAWN dark painterly paper cavern fantasy game. A single refined small antique paper plaque with deep charcoal fiber paper center, subtle layered torn edges and very restrained worn bronze/bookbinder corners. No book spread, no website card look. Large clean empty center for title and two lines of text. Top center a tiny restrained antique bookmark ornament. Exactly TWO side-by-side blank rectangular dark paper button recesses integrated along bottom at centers x=30% and x=70%, y=78%, each width 30% height 13%. No lettering, no icons inside buttons. Delicate warm ivory edges, desaturated taupe graphite palette, soft textured illustrated style, simple hierarchy, broadly readable empty space. Background outside the panel silhouette MUST be fully transparent alpha. Entire panel has generous transparent padding 4% around it. NO words, NO letters, NO extra props, NO symbols resembling health leaves. Highest practical resolution.
